method: Cosine similarity over log(text/data/bss size, function count, in/out degree, in/out cross-overlay relocation totals), blended 0.6/0.2/0.2 with a degree-profile shape term and a function-count ratio term. No neighbour-identity subgraph matching -- overlay numbers are not comparable across the two games.

self_test_jfg_us_vs_kiosk.note: JFG-us vs JFG-kiosk is the SAME game at two revisions, so this upper-bounds what a size/count/degree profile can recover; the Mickey<->JFG problem is strictly harder (different game, different revision, resident-vs-overlay boundary moved).
